WHAT IS AND IS NOT HERE
1009 people and 20 houses, 918 stated descents and 100 implied ones.
The deepest line runs 64 generations, Adam to Hodaviah son of Elioenai.
Dan and Zebulun are named among Israel's sons and then never traced — Chronicles
gives them no genealogy at all.
City and town lists (6:54-81, 4:28-33), the Hagrite war and the gatekeepers' duty
roster are left out; the people named inside them are kept.
Chronicles repeats names freely. Where two passages give one man two fathers, both
lines are drawn and the box says so.
